# yoinkr

> yoinkr is a free web tool for downloading YouTube videos and audio. Paste a YouTube link, choose a resolution (from the video's original quality down to 144p) or extract just the audio as an MP3, and download the file directly in the browser. No account or sign-up is required.

## Pages

- [Home](https://yoinkr.online/): The main tool. Paste a YouTube URL, fetch its available resolutions, and download video or audio.
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoinkr.online/privacy): How yoinkr handles data, cookies, and advertising.
- [Terms of Service](https://yoinkr.online/terms): The terms that apply to using the service.

## Notes

- yoinkr does not store downloaded files after they are served to the requesting user.
- yoinkr is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
- A paid desktop app is planned, which will run locally on the user's own machine. There is a waitlist signup on the home page.
